verdict.rationale: Receiving funds into local account details in multiple currencies is a fair question for a business banking product, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers USD-centric capabilities: sending no-fee USD payments globally, outbound international wires, and collecting invoices by card or ACH debit. Nothing in the pack shows Mercury issuing local receiving details (such as EUR IBAN or GBP sort code) or holding non-USD balances.
